before filing: a card is a stress-test instrument used after the candidate set is frozen,
never evidence, a candidate generator, or a novelty source.

## Card family

- [ ] `iclr-pattern-*` — a public argument-structure catalogue card
- [ ] `personal-pattern-*` — a profile-specific precedent (belongs in a profile, not in
      the shipped default, unless you are the profile's author)
